exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: existing game diffuse texture; faithful subtle HD painted refinement, not a photograph or object render.

Edit target: the sole attached opaque RGB guide is the ENTIRE original native128x128 canvas nearest-resized4x to512x512. Keep entire source framing, normalized UV coordinates, counts, silhouettes, black/shadow fields and source-scale pattern exactly; output fills the same square with no border, zoom, crop or padding.

Three existing vertical strap-like painted fields: one in the left-middle at native x58..68,y35..70 and two at upper-right x90..100,y21..57 and x107..117,y21..58. Preserve every small pale bar/slot and dark gap within them exactly, with no new buckle parts. Keep the large olive cloth regions, orange-brown lower-left field and weak bottom curved gray mark unchanged in positions/scale.

Materials and tone: original subdued matte painted palette. Add only very fine paint detail inside existing source appearance, retaining its broad shading and softness. No photographic grain, new weave, stronger creases, raised rim, bright metallic rods/gloss, new stripes, scratches or marks. Dim original light patches stay dim, with original relative intensity hierarchy. Existing dark RGB is source color/shadow, not a reason to add geometry.

Exact source-native diagnostic assertions (positions refer to128x128 canvas; guide is4x): [{"name":"left vertical strap","diagnostic_native_domain":[58,35,69,71],"source_peak_xy":[60,44],"source_peak_RGB":[222,219,181],"source_RGB_mean":[82.62878787878788,74.28535353535354,35.946969696969695]},{"name":"upper-right first vertical strap","diagnostic_native_domain":[90,21,101,58],"source_peak_xy":[91,37],"source_peak_RGB":[231,227,222],"source_RGB_mean":[79.12530712530713,71.65601965601965,36.31449631449632]},{"name":"upper-right second vertical strap","diagnostic_native_domain":[107,21,118,59],"source_peak_xy":[108,37],"source_peak_RGB":[231,235,231],"source_RGB_mean":[81.84928229665071,74.44497607655502,36.64114832535885]}]

Constraints: preserve the full source texture arrangement and exact detail count/phase/pattern-scale. Do not add or remove a tab, strap, loop, fastener, hole, band, line, symbol or blade part. Keep existing tiny details as faint painted shapes rather than sharper or larger hardware. The engine restores original source alpha separately; provide opaque storedRGB over all original source fields and black UV background. No text, logos, decorative curls or new repeating texture.
